# Easy Image Converter (easy-converter.gribcov.me)

> Free, private, client-side and cloud-optimized image converter. Converts between HEIC, WebP, PNG, JPG, and other modern image formats.

## Key Features
- High-speed image format conversion (HEIC to JPG, WebP to PNG, PNG to WebP, JPG to WebP).
- Privacy-focused: batch processing with fast client-side performance.
- Clean web interface, zero installation required.
